[224](https://docs.rs#224)    /// # Example
[225](https://docs.rs#225)    ///
[226](https://docs.rs#226)    /// ```
[227](https://docs.rs#227)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[228](https://docs.rs#228)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[229](https://docs.rs#229)    /// let mut cache: LruCache<isize, &str> = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(10).unwrap());
[230](https://docs.rs#230)    /// ```
[231](https://docs.rs#231)    pub fn new(cap: NonZeroUsize) -> LruCache<K, V> {
[232](https://docs.rs#232)        LruCache::construct(cap, HashMap::with_capacity(cap.get()))
[233](https://docs.rs#233)    }
[234](https://docs.rs#234)
[235](https://docs.rs#235)    /// Creates a new LRU Cache that never automatically evicts items.
[236](https://docs.rs#236)    ///
[237](https://docs.rs#237)    /// # Example
[238](https://docs.rs#238)    ///
[239](https://docs.rs#239)    /// ```
[240](https://docs.rs#240)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[241](https://docs.rs#241)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[242](https://docs.rs#242)    /// let mut cache: LruCache<isize, &str> = LruCache::unbounded();
[243](https://docs.rs#243)    /// ```
[244](https://docs.rs#244)    pub fn unbounded() -> LruCache<K, V> {
[245](https://docs.rs#245)        LruCache::construct(NonZeroUsize::MAX, HashMap::default())
[246](https://docs.rs#246)    }
[247](https://docs.rs#247)}
[248](https://docs.rs#248)
[249](https://docs.rs#249)impl<K: Hash + Eq, V, S: BuildHasher> LruCache<K, V, S> {
[250](https://docs.rs#250)    /// Creates a new LRU Cache that holds at most `cap` items and
[251](https://docs.rs#251)    /// uses the provided hash builder to hash keys.
[252](https://docs.rs#252)    ///
[253](https://docs.rs#253)    /// # Example
[254](https://docs.rs#254)    ///
[255](https://docs.rs#255)    /// ```
[256](https://docs.rs#256)    /// use lru::{LruCache, DefaultHasher};
[257](https://docs.rs#257)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[258](https://docs.rs#258)    ///
[259](https://docs.rs#259)    /// let s = DefaultHasher::default();
[260](https://docs.rs#260)    /// let mut cache: LruCache<isize, &str> = LruCache::with_hasher(NonZeroUsize::new(10).unwrap(), s);
[261](https://docs.rs#261)    /// ```
[262](https://docs.rs#262)    pub fn with_hasher(cap: NonZeroUsize, hash_builder: S) -> LruCache<K, V, S> {
[263](https://docs.rs#263)        LruCache::construct(
[264](https://docs.rs#264)            cap,
[265](https://docs.rs#265)            HashMap::with_capacity_and_hasher(cap.into(), hash_builder),
[266](https://docs.rs#266)        )
[267](https://docs.rs#267)    }
[268](https://docs.rs#268)
[269](https://docs.rs#269)    /// Creates a new LRU Cache that never automatically evicts items and
[270](https://docs.rs#270)    /// uses the provided hash builder to hash keys.
[271](https://docs.rs#271)    ///
[272](https://docs.rs#272)    /// # Example
[273](https://docs.rs#273)    ///
[274](https://docs.rs#274)    /// ```
[275](https://docs.rs#275)    /// use lru::{LruCache, DefaultHasher};
[276](https://docs.rs#276)    ///
[277](https://docs.rs#277)    /// let s = DefaultHasher::default();
[278](https://docs.rs#278)    /// let mut cache: LruCache<isize, &str> = LruCache::unbounded_with_hasher(s);
[279](https://docs.rs#279)    /// ```
[280](https://docs.rs#280)    pub fn unbounded_with_hasher(hash_builder: S) -> LruCache<K, V, S> {
[281](https://docs.rs#281)        LruCache::construct(NonZeroUsize::MAX, HashMap::with_hasher(hash_builder))
[282](https://docs.rs#282)    }
[283](https://docs.rs#283)
[284](https://docs.rs#284)    /// Creates a new LRU Cache with the given capacity.
[285](https://docs.rs#285)    fn construct(
[286](https://docs.rs#286)        cap: NonZeroUsize,
[287](https://docs.rs#287)        map: HashMap<KeyRef<K>, NonNull<LruEntry<K, V>>, S>,
[288](https://docs.rs#288)    ) -> LruCache<K, V, S> {
[289](https://docs.rs#289)        // NB: The compiler warns that cache does not need to be marked as mutable if we
[290](https://docs.rs#290)        // declare it as such since we only mutate it inside the unsafe block.
[291](https://docs.rs#291)        let cache = LruCache {
[292](https://docs.rs#292)            map,
[293](https://docs.rs#293)            cap,
[294](https://docs.rs#294)            head: Box::into_raw(Box::new(LruEntry::new_sigil())),
[295](https://docs.rs#295)            tail: Box::into_raw(Box::new(LruEntry::new_sigil())),
[296](https://docs.rs#296)        };
[297](https://docs.rs#297)
[298](https://docs.rs#298)        unsafe {
[299](https://docs.rs#299)            (*cache.head).next = cache.tail;
[300](https://docs.rs#300)            (*cache.tail).prev = cache.head;
[301](https://docs.rs#301)        }
[302](https://docs.rs#302)
[303](https://docs.rs#303)        cache
[304](https://docs.rs#304)    }
[305](https://docs.rs#305)
[306](https://docs.rs#306)    /// Whether this LRU cache is unbounded.
[307](https://docs.rs#307)    fn is_unbounded(&self) -> bool {
[308](https://docs.rs#308)        self.cap() == NonZeroUsize::MAX
[309](https://docs.rs#309)    }
[310](https://docs.rs#310)
[311](https://docs.rs#311)    /// Puts a key-value pair into cache. If the key already exists in the cache, then it updates
[312](https://docs.rs#312)    /// the key's value and returns the old value. Otherwise, `None` is returned.
[313](https://docs.rs#313)    ///
[314](https://docs.rs#314)    /// # Example
[315](https://docs.rs#315)    ///
[316](https://docs.rs#316)    /// ```
[317](https://docs.rs#317)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[318](https://docs.rs#318)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[319](https://docs.rs#319)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[320](https://docs.rs#320)    ///
[321](https://docs.rs#321)    /// assert_eq!(None, cache.put(1, "a"));
[322](https://docs.rs#322)    /// assert_eq!(None, cache.put(2, "b"));
[323](https://docs.rs#323)    /// assert_eq!(Some("b"), cache.put(2, "beta"));
[324](https://docs.rs#324)    ///
[325](https://docs.rs#325)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&1), Some(&"a"));
[326](https://docs.rs#326)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&2), Some(&"beta"));
[327](https://docs.rs#327)    /// ```
[328](https://docs.rs#328)    pub fn put(&mut self, k: K, v: V) -> Option<V> {
[329](https://docs.rs#329)        self.capturing_put(k, v, false).map(|(_, v)| v)
[330](https://docs.rs#330)    }
[331](https://docs.rs#331)
[332](https://docs.rs#332)    /// Pushes a key-value pair into the cache. If an entry with key `k` already exists in
[333](https://docs.rs#333)    /// the cache or another cache entry is removed (due to the lru's capacity),
[334](https://docs.rs#334)    /// then it returns the old entry's key-value pair. Otherwise, returns `None`.
[335](https://docs.rs#335)    ///
[336](https://docs.rs#336)    /// # Example
[337](https://docs.rs#337)    ///
[338](https://docs.rs#338)    /// ```
[339](https://docs.rs#339)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[340](https://docs.rs#340)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[341](https://docs.rs#341)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[342](https://docs.rs#342)    ///
[343](https://docs.rs#343)    /// assert_eq!(None, cache.push(1, "a"));
[344](https://docs.rs#344)    /// assert_eq!(None, cache.push(2, "b"));
[345](https://docs.rs#345)    ///
[346](https://docs.rs#346)    /// // This push call returns (2, "b") because that was previously 2's entry in the cache.
[347](https://docs.rs#347)    /// assert_eq!(Some((2, "b")), cache.push(2, "beta"));
[348](https://docs.rs#348)    ///
[349](https://docs.rs#349)    /// // This push call returns (1, "a") because the cache is at capacity and 1's entry was the lru entry.
[350](https://docs.rs#350)    /// assert_eq!(Some((1, "a")), cache.push(3, "alpha"));
[351](https://docs.rs#351)    ///
[352](https://docs.rs#352)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&1), None);
[353](https://docs.rs#353)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&2), Some(&"beta"));
[354](https://docs.rs#354)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&3), Some(&"alpha"));
[355](https://docs.rs#355)    /// ```
[356](https://docs.rs#356)    pub fn push(&mut self, k: K, v: V) -> Option<(K, V)> {
[357](https://docs.rs#357)        self.capturing_put(k, v, true)
[358](https://docs.rs#358)    }
[359](https://docs.rs#359)
[360](https://docs.rs#360)    // Used internally by `put` and `push` to add a new entry to the lru.
[361](https://docs.rs#361)    // Takes ownership of and returns entries replaced due to the cache's capacity
[362](https://docs.rs#362)    // when `capture` is true.
[363](https://docs.rs#363)    fn capturing_put(&mut self, k: K, mut v: V, capture: bool) -> Option<(K, V)> {
[364](https://docs.rs#364)        let node_ref = self.map.get_mut(&KeyRef { k: &k });
[365](https://docs.rs#365)
[366](https://docs.rs#366)        match node_ref {
[367](https://docs.rs#367)            Some(node_ref) => {
[368](https://docs.rs#368)                // if the key is already in the cache just update its value and move it to the
[369](https://docs.rs#369)                // front of the list
[370](https://docs.rs#370)                let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node_ref.as_ptr();
[371](https://docs.rs#371)
[372](https://docs.rs#372)                // gets a reference to the node to perform a swap and drops it right after
[373](https://docs.rs#373)                let node_ref = unsafe { &mut (*(*node_ptr).val.as_mut_ptr()) };
[374](https://docs.rs#374)                mem::swap(&mut v, node_ref);
[375](https://docs.rs#375)                let _ = node_ref;
[376](https://docs.rs#376)
[377](https://docs.rs#377)                self.detach(node_ptr);
[378](https://docs.rs#378)                self.attach(node_ptr);
[379](https://docs.rs#379)                Some((k, v))
[380](https://docs.rs#380)            }
[381](https://docs.rs#381)            None => {
[382](https://docs.rs#382)                let (replaced, node) = self.replace_or_create_node(k, v);
[383](https://docs.rs#383)                let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[384](https://docs.rs#384)
[385](https://docs.rs#385)                self.attach(node_ptr);
[386](https://docs.rs#386)
[387](https://docs.rs#387)                let keyref = unsafe { (*node_ptr).key.as_ptr() };
[388](https://docs.rs#388)                self.map.insert(KeyRef { k: keyref }, node);
[389](https://docs.rs#389)
[390](https://docs.rs#390)                replaced.filter(|_| capture)
[391](https://docs.rs#391)            }
[392](https://docs.rs#392)        }
[393](https://docs.rs#393)    }
[394](https://docs.rs#394)
[395](https://docs.rs#395)    // Used internally to swap out a node if the cache is full or to create a new node if space
[396](https://docs.rs#396)    // is available. Shared between `put`, `push`, `get_or_insert`, and `get_or_insert_mut`.
[397](https://docs.rs#397)    #[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]
[398](https://docs.rs#398)    fn replace_or_create_node(&mut self, k: K, v: V) -> (Option<(K, V)>, NonNull<LruEntry<K, V>>) {
[399](https://docs.rs#399)        if self.len() == self.cap().get() {
[400](https://docs.rs#400)            // if the cache is full, remove the last entry so we can use it for the new key
[401](https://docs.rs#401)            let old_key = KeyRef {
[402](https://docs.rs#402)                k: unsafe { &(*(*(*self.tail).prev).key.as_ptr()) },
[403](https://docs.rs#403)            };
[404](https://docs.rs#404)            let old_node = self.map.remove(&old_key).unwrap();
[405](https://docs.rs#405)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = old_node.as_ptr();
[406](https://docs.rs#406)
[407](https://docs.rs#407)            // read out the node's old key and value and then replace it
[408](https://docs.rs#408)            let replaced = unsafe {
[409](https://docs.rs#409)                (
[410](https://docs.rs#410)                    mem::replace(&mut (*node_ptr).key, mem::MaybeUninit::new(k)).assume_init(),
[411](https://docs.rs#411)                    mem::replace(&mut (*node_ptr).val, mem::MaybeUninit::new(v)).assume_init(),
[412](https://docs.rs#412)                )
[413](https://docs.rs#413)            };
[414](https://docs.rs#414)
[415](https://docs.rs#415)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[416](https://docs.rs#416)
[417](https://docs.rs#417)            (Some(replaced), old_node)
[418](https://docs.rs#418)        } else {
[419](https://docs.rs#419)            // if the cache is not full allocate a new LruEntry
[420](https://docs.rs#420)            // Safety: We allocate, turn into raw, and get NonNull all in one step.
[421](https://docs.rs#421)            (None, unsafe {
[422](https://docs.rs#422)                NonNull::new_unchecked(Box::into_raw(Box::new(LruEntry::new(k, v))))
[423](https://docs.rs#423)            })
[424](https://docs.rs#424)        }
[425](https://docs.rs#425)    }
[426](https://docs.rs#426)
[427](https://docs.rs#427)    /// Returns a reference to the value of the key in the cache or `None` if it is not
[428](https://docs.rs#428)    /// present in the cache. Moves the key to the head of the LRU list if it exists.
[429](https://docs.rs#429)    ///
[430](https://docs.rs#430)    /// # Example
[431](https://docs.rs#431)    ///
[432](https://docs.rs#432)    /// ```
[433](https://docs.rs#433)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[434](https://docs.rs#434)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[435](https://docs.rs#435)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[436](https://docs.rs#436)    ///
[437](https://docs.rs#437)    /// cache.put(1, "a");
[438](https://docs.rs#438)    /// cache.put(2, "b");
[439](https://docs.rs#439)    /// cache.put(2, "c");
[440](https://docs.rs#440)    /// cache.put(3, "d");
[441](https://docs.rs#441)    ///
[442](https://docs.rs#442)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&1), None);
[443](https://docs.rs#443)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&2), Some(&"c"));
[444](https://docs.rs#444)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&3), Some(&"d"));
[445](https://docs.rs#445)    /// ```
[446](https://docs.rs#446)    pub fn get<'a, Q>(&'a mut self, k: &Q) -> Option<&'a V>
[447](https://docs.rs#447)    where
[448](https://docs.rs#448)        K: Borrow<Q>,
[449](https://docs.rs#449)        Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized,
[450](https://docs.rs#450)    {
[451](https://docs.rs#451)        if let Some(node) = self.map.get_mut(KeyWrapper::from_ref(k)) {
[452](https://docs.rs#452)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[453](https://docs.rs#453)
[454](https://docs.rs#454)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[455](https://docs.rs#455)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[456](https://docs.rs#456)
[457](https://docs.rs#457)            Some(unsafe { &*(*node_ptr).val.as_ptr() })
[458](https://docs.rs#458)        } else {
[459](https://docs.rs#459)            None
[460](https://docs.rs#460)        }
[461](https://docs.rs#461)    }
[462](https://docs.rs#462)
[463](https://docs.rs#463)    /// Returns a mutable reference to the value of the key in the cache or `None` if it
[464](https://docs.rs#464)    /// is not present in the cache. Moves the key to the head of the LRU list if it exists.
[465](https://docs.rs#465)    ///
[466](https://docs.rs#466)    /// # Example

[481](https://docs.rs#481)    /// ```
[482](https://docs.rs#482)    pub fn get_mut<'a, Q>(&'a mut self, k: &Q) -> Option<&'a mut V>
[483](https://docs.rs#483)    where
[484](https://docs.rs#484)        K: Borrow<Q>,
[485](https://docs.rs#485)        Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized,
[486](https://docs.rs#486)    {
[487](https://docs.rs#487)        if let Some(node) = self.map.get_mut(KeyWrapper::from_ref(k)) {
[488](https://docs.rs#488)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[489](https://docs.rs#489)
[490](https://docs.rs#490)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[491](https://docs.rs#491)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[492](https://docs.rs#492)
[493](https://docs.rs#493)            Some(unsafe { &mut *(*node_ptr).val.as_mut_ptr() })
[494](https://docs.rs#494)        } else {
[495](https://docs.rs#495)            None
[496](https://docs.rs#496)        }
[497](https://docs.rs#497)    }

[499](https://docs.rs#499)    /// Returns a key-value references pair of the key in the cache or `None` if it is not
[500](https://docs.rs#500)    /// present in the cache. Moves the key to the head of the LRU list if it exists.
[501](https://docs.rs#501)    ///
[502](https://docs.rs#502)    /// # Example
[503](https://docs.rs#503)    ///
[504](https://docs.rs#504)    /// ```
[505](https://docs.rs#505)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[506](https://docs.rs#506)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[507](https://docs.rs#507)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[508](https://docs.rs#508)    ///
[509](https://docs.rs#509)    /// cache.put(String::from("1"), "a");
[510](https://docs.rs#510)    /// cache.put(String::from("2"), "b");
[511](https://docs.rs#511)    /// cache.put(String::from("2"), "c");
[512](https://docs.rs#512)    /// cache.put(String::from("3"), "d");
[513](https://docs.rs#513)    ///
[514](https://docs.rs#514)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_key_value("1"), None);
[515](https://docs.rs#515)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_key_value("2"), Some((&String::from("2"), &"c")));
[516](https://docs.rs#516)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_key_value("3"), Some((&String::from("3"), &"d")));
[517](https://docs.rs#517)    /// ```
[518](https://docs.rs#518)    pub fn get_key_value<'a, Q>(&'a mut self, k: &Q) -> Option<(&'a K, &'a V)>
[519](https://docs.rs#519)    where
[520](https://docs.rs#520)        K: Borrow<Q>,
[521](https://docs.rs#521)        Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized,
[522](https://docs.rs#522)    {
[523](https://docs.rs#523)        if let Some(node) = self.map.get_mut(KeyWrapper::from_ref(k)) {
[524](https://docs.rs#524)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[525](https://docs.rs#525)
[526](https://docs.rs#526)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[527](https://docs.rs#527)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[528](https://docs.rs#528)
[529](https://docs.rs#529)            Some(unsafe { (&*(*node_ptr).key.as_ptr(), &*(*node_ptr).val.as_ptr()) })
[530](https://docs.rs#530)        } else {
[531](https://docs.rs#531)            None
[532](https://docs.rs#532)        }
[533](https://docs.rs#533)    }
[534](https://docs.rs#534)
[535](https://docs.rs#535)    /// Returns a key-value references pair of the key in the cache or `None` if it is not
[536](https://docs.rs#536)    /// present in the cache. The reference to the value of the key is mutable. Moves the key to
[537](https://docs.rs#537)    /// the head of the LRU list if it exists.
[538](https://docs.rs#538)    ///
[539](https://docs.rs#539)    /// # Example
[540](https://docs.rs#540)    ///
[541](https://docs.rs#541)    /// ```
[542](https://docs.rs#542)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[543](https://docs.rs#543)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[544](https://docs.rs#544)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[545](https://docs.rs#545)    ///
[546](https://docs.rs#546)    /// cache.put(1, "a");
[547](https://docs.rs#547)    /// cache.put(2, "b");
[548](https://docs.rs#548)    /// let (k, v) = cache.get_key_value_mut(&1).unwrap();
[549](https://docs.rs#549)    /// assert_eq!(k, &1);
[550](https://docs.rs#550)    /// assert_eq!(v, &mut "a");
[551](https://docs.rs#551)    /// *v = "aa";
[552](https://docs.rs#552)    /// cache.put(3, "c");
[553](https://docs.rs#553)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_key_value(&2), None);
[554](https://docs.rs#554)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_key_value(&1), Some((&1, &"aa")));
[555](https://docs.rs#555)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_key_value(&3), Some((&3, &"c")));
[556](https://docs.rs#556)    /// ```
[557](https://docs.rs#557)    pub fn get_key_value_mut<'a, Q>(&'a mut self, k: &Q) -> Option<(&'a K, &'a mut V)>
[558](https://docs.rs#558)    where
[559](https://docs.rs#559)        K: Borrow<Q>,
[560](https://docs.rs#560)        Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized,
[561](https://docs.rs#561)    {
[562](https://docs.rs#562)        if let Some(node) = self.map.get_mut(KeyWrapper::from_ref(k)) {
[563](https://docs.rs#563)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[564](https://docs.rs#564)
[565](https://docs.rs#565)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[566](https://docs.rs#566)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[567](https://docs.rs#567)
[568](https://docs.rs#568)            Some(unsafe {
[569](https://docs.rs#569)                (
[570](https://docs.rs#570)                    &*(*node_ptr).key.as_ptr(),
[571](https://docs.rs#571)                    &mut *(*node_ptr).val.as_mut_ptr(),
[572](https://docs.rs#572)                )
[573](https://docs.rs#573)            })
[574](https://docs.rs#574)        } else {
[575](https://docs.rs#575)            None
[576](https://docs.rs#576)        }
[577](https://docs.rs#577)    }
[578](https://docs.rs#578)
[579](https://docs.rs#579)    /// Returns a reference to the value of the key in the cache if it is
[580](https://docs.rs#580)    /// present in the cache and moves the key to the head of the LRU list.
[581](https://docs.rs#581)    /// If the key does not exist the provided `FnOnce` is used to populate
[582](https://docs.rs#582)    /// the list and a reference is returned.
[583](https://docs.rs#583)    ///
[584](https://docs.rs#584)    /// # Example
[585](https://docs.rs#585)    ///
[586](https://docs.rs#586)    /// ```
[587](https://docs.rs#587)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[588](https://docs.rs#588)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[589](https://docs.rs#589)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[590](https://docs.rs#590)    ///
[591](https://docs.rs#591)    /// cache.put(1, "a");
[592](https://docs.rs#592)    /// cache.put(2, "b");
[593](https://docs.rs#593)    /// cache.put(2, "c");
[594](https://docs.rs#594)    /// cache.put(3, "d");
[595](https://docs.rs#595)    ///
[596](https://docs.rs#596)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert(2, ||"a"), &"c");
[597](https://docs.rs#597)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert(3, ||"a"), &"d");
[598](https://docs.rs#598)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert(1, ||"a"), &"a");
[599](https://docs.rs#599)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert(1, ||"b"), &"a");
[600](https://docs.rs#600)    /// ```
[601](https://docs.rs#601)    pub fn get_or_insert<F>(&mut self, k: K, f: F) -> &V
[602](https://docs.rs#602)    where
[603](https://docs.rs#603)        F: FnOnce() -> V,
[604](https://docs.rs#604)    {
[605](https://docs.rs#605)        self.get_or_insert_with_key(k, |_| f())
[606](https://docs.rs#606)    }
[607](https://docs.rs#607)
[608](https://docs.rs#608)    /// Returns a reference to the value of the key in the cache if it is
[609](https://docs.rs#609)    /// present in the cache and moves the key to the head of the LRU list.
[610](https://docs.rs#610)    /// If the key does not exist the provided `FnOnce` is used by passing
[611](https://docs.rs#611)    /// a reference to the key to populate the list and a reference is returned.
[612](https://docs.rs#612)    ///
[613](https://docs.rs#613)    /// # Example
[614](https://docs.rs#614)    ///
[615](https://docs.rs#615)    /// ```
[616](https://docs.rs#616)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[617](https://docs.rs#617)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[618](https://docs.rs#618)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[619](https://docs.rs#619)    ///
[620](https://docs.rs#620)    /// cache.put("One", 1);
[621](https://docs.rs#621)    /// cache.put("Two", 2);
[622](https://docs.rs#622)    /// cache.put("Two", 3);
[623](https://docs.rs#623)    /// cache.put("Three", 4);
[624](https://docs.rs#624)    ///
[625](https://docs.rs#625)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_with_key("Two", |_|1), &3);
[626](https://docs.rs#626)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_with_key("Three", |k|k.len()), &4);
[627](https://docs.rs#627)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_with_key("One", |_|1), &1);
[628](https://docs.rs#628)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_with_key("One", |k|k.len()), &1);
[629](https://docs.rs#629)    /// ```
[630](https://docs.rs#630)    pub fn get_or_insert_with_key<F>(&mut self, k: K, f: F) -> &V
[631](https://docs.rs#631)    where
[632](https://docs.rs#632)        F: FnOnce(&K) -> V,
[633](https://docs.rs#633)    {
[634](https://docs.rs#634)        if let Some(node) = self.map.get_mut(&KeyRef { k: &k }) {
[635](https://docs.rs#635)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[636](https://docs.rs#636)
[637](https://docs.rs#637)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[638](https://docs.rs#638)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[639](https://docs.rs#639)
[640](https://docs.rs#640)            unsafe { &*(*node_ptr).val.as_ptr() }
[641](https://docs.rs#641)        } else {
[642](https://docs.rs#642)            let v = f(&k);
[643](https://docs.rs#643)            let (_, node) = self.replace_or_create_node(k, v);
[644](https://docs.rs#644)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[645](https://docs.rs#645)
[646](https://docs.rs#646)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[647](https://docs.rs#647)
[648](https://docs.rs#648)            let keyref = unsafe { (*node_ptr).key.as_ptr() };
[649](https://docs.rs#649)            self.map.insert(KeyRef { k: keyref }, node);
[650](https://docs.rs#650)            unsafe { &*(*node_ptr).val.as_ptr() }
[651](https://docs.rs#651)        }
[652](https://docs.rs#652)    }
[653](https://docs.rs#653)
[654](https://docs.rs#654)    /// Returns a reference to the value of the key in the cache if it is
[655](https://docs.rs#655)    /// present in the cache and moves the key to the head of the LRU list.
[656](https://docs.rs#656)    /// If the key does not exist the provided `FnOnce` is used to populate
[657](https://docs.rs#657)    /// the list and a reference is returned. The value referenced by the
[658](https://docs.rs#658)    /// key is only cloned (using `to_owned()`) if it doesn't exist in the
[659](https://docs.rs#659)    /// cache.
[660](https://docs.rs#660)    ///
[661](https://docs.rs#661)    /// # Example
[662](https://docs.rs#662)    ///
[663](https://docs.rs#663)    /// ```
[664](https://docs.rs#664)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[665](https://docs.rs#665)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[666](https://docs.rs#666)    /// use std::rc::Rc;
[667](https://docs.rs#667)    ///
[668](https://docs.rs#668)    /// let key1 = Rc::new("1".to_owned());
[669](https://docs.rs#669)    /// let key2 = Rc::new("2".to_owned());
[670](https://docs.rs#670)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::<Rc<String>, String>::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[671](https://docs.rs#671)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_ref(&key1, ||"One".to_owned()), "One");
[672](https://docs.rs#672)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_ref(&key2, ||"Two".to_owned()), "Two");
[673](https://docs.rs#673)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_ref(&key2, ||"Not two".to_owned()), "Two");
[674](https://docs.rs#674)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_ref(&key2, ||"Again not two".to_owned()), "Two");
[675](https://docs.rs#675)    /// assert_eq!(Rc::strong_count(&key1), 2);
[676](https://docs.rs#676)    /// assert_eq!(Rc::strong_count(&key2), 2); // key2 was only cloned once even though we
[677](https://docs.rs#677)    ///                                         // queried it 3 times
[678](https://docs.rs#678)    /// ```
[679](https://docs.rs#679)    pub fn get_or_insert_ref<'a, Q, F>(&'a mut self, k: &'_ Q, f: F) -> &'a V
[680](https://docs.rs#680)    where
[681](https://docs.rs#681)        K: Borrow<Q>,
[682](https://docs.rs#682)        Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized + alloc::borrow::ToOwned<Owned = K>,
[683](https://docs.rs#683)        F: FnOnce() -> V,
[684](https://docs.rs#684)    {
[685](https://docs.rs#685)        if let Some(node) = self.map.get_mut(KeyWrapper::from_ref(k)) {
[686](https://docs.rs#686)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[687](https://docs.rs#687)
[688](https://docs.rs#688)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[689](https://docs.rs#689)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[690](https://docs.rs#690)
[691](https://docs.rs#691)            unsafe { &*(*node_ptr).val.as_ptr() }
[692](https://docs.rs#692)        } else {
[693](https://docs.rs#693)            let v = f();
[694](https://docs.rs#694)            let (_, node) = self.replace_or_create_node(k.to_owned(), v);
[695](https://docs.rs#695)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[696](https://docs.rs#696)
[697](https://docs.rs#697)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[698](https://docs.rs#698)
[699](https://docs.rs#699)            let keyref = unsafe { (*node_ptr).key.as_ptr() };
[700](https://docs.rs#700)            self.map.insert(KeyRef { k: keyref }, node);
[701](https://docs.rs#701)            unsafe { &*(*node_ptr).val.as_ptr() }
[702](https://docs.rs#702)        }
[703](https://docs.rs#703)    }

[874](https://docs.rs#874)    /// Returns a mutable reference to the value of the key in the cache if it is
[875](https://docs.rs#875)    /// present in the cache and moves the key to the head of the LRU list.
[876](https://docs.rs#876)    /// If the key does not exist the provided `FnOnce` is used by passing
[877](https://docs.rs#877)    /// a reference to the key to populate the list and a mutable reference
[878](https://docs.rs#878)    /// is returned.
[879](https://docs.rs#879)    ///
[880](https://docs.rs#880)    /// # Example
[881](https://docs.rs#881)    ///
[882](https://docs.rs#882)    /// ```
[883](https://docs.rs#883)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[884](https://docs.rs#884)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[885](https://docs.rs#885)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[886](https://docs.rs#886)    ///
[887](https://docs.rs#887)    /// cache.put("One", 1);
[888](https://docs.rs#888)    /// cache.put("Two", 2);
[889](https://docs.rs#889)    /// cache.put("Two", 3);
[890](https://docs.rs#890)    /// cache.put("Three", 4);
[891](https://docs.rs#891)    ///
[892](https://docs.rs#892)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_mut_with_key("Two", |_|1), &mut 3);
[893](https://docs.rs#893)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_mut_with_key("Three", |k|k.len()), &mut 4);
[894](https://docs.rs#894)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_mut_with_key("One", |_|1), &mut 1);
[895](https://docs.rs#895)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_mut_with_key("One", |k|k.len()), &mut 1);
[896](https://docs.rs#896)    /// ```
[897](https://docs.rs#897)    pub fn get_or_insert_mut_with_key<F>(&mut self, k: K, f: F) -> &mut V
[898](https://docs.rs#898)    where
[899](https://docs.rs#899)        F: FnOnce(&K) -> V,
[900](https://docs.rs#900)    {
[901](https://docs.rs#901)        if let Some(node) = self.map.get_mut(&KeyRef { k: &k }) {
[902](https://docs.rs#902)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[903](https://docs.rs#903)
[904](https://docs.rs#904)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[905](https://docs.rs#905)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[906](https://docs.rs#906)
[907](https://docs.rs#907)            unsafe { &mut *(*node_ptr).val.as_mut_ptr() }
[908](https://docs.rs#908)        } else {
[909](https://docs.rs#909)            let v = f(&k);
[910](https://docs.rs#910)            let (_, node) = self.replace_or_create_node(k, v);
[911](https://docs.rs#911)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[912](https://docs.rs#912)
[913](https://docs.rs#913)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[914](https://docs.rs#914)
[915](https://docs.rs#915)            let keyref = unsafe { (*node_ptr).key.as_ptr() };
[916](https://docs.rs#916)            self.map.insert(KeyRef { k: keyref }, node);
[917](https://docs.rs#917)            unsafe { &mut *(*node_ptr).val.as_mut_ptr() }
[918](https://docs.rs#918)        }
[919](https://docs.rs#919)    }

[921](https://docs.rs#921)    /// Returns a mutable reference to the value of the key in the cache if it is
[922](https://docs.rs#922)    /// present in the cache and moves the key to the head of the LRU list.
[923](https://docs.rs#923)    /// If the key does not exist the provided `FnOnce` is used to populate
[924](https://docs.rs#924)    /// the list and a mutable reference is returned. The value referenced by the
[925](https://docs.rs#925)    /// key is only cloned (using `to_owned()`) if it doesn't exist in the cache.
[926](https://docs.rs#926)    ///
[927](https://docs.rs#927)    /// # Example
[928](https://docs.rs#928)    ///
[929](https://docs.rs#929)    /// ```
[930](https://docs.rs#930)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[931](https://docs.rs#931)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[932](https://docs.rs#932)    /// use std::rc::Rc;
[933](https://docs.rs#933)    ///
[934](https://docs.rs#934)    /// let key1 = Rc::new("1".to_owned());
[935](https://docs.rs#935)    /// let key2 = Rc::new("2".to_owned());
[936](https://docs.rs#936)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::<Rc<String>, &'static str>::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[937](https://docs.rs#937)    /// cache.get_or_insert_mut_ref(&key1, ||"One");
[938](https://docs.rs#938)    /// let v = cache.get_or_insert_mut_ref(&key2, ||"Two");
[939](https://docs.rs#939)    /// *v = "New two";
[940](https://docs.rs#940)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_mut_ref(&key2, ||"Two"), &mut "New two");
[941](https://docs.rs#941)    /// assert_eq!(Rc::strong_count(&key1), 2);
[942](https://docs.rs#942)    /// assert_eq!(Rc::strong_count(&key2), 2); // key2 was only cloned once even though we
[943](https://docs.rs#943)    ///                                         // queried it 2 times
[944](https://docs.rs#944)    /// ```
[945](https://docs.rs#945)    pub fn get_or_insert_mut_ref<'a, Q, F>(&'a mut self, k: &'_ Q, f: F) -> &'a mut V
[946](https://docs.rs#946)    where
[947](https://docs.rs#947)        K: Borrow<Q>,
[948](https://docs.rs#948)        Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized + alloc::borrow::ToOwned<Owned = K>,
[949](https://docs.rs#949)        F: FnOnce() -> V,
[950](https://docs.rs#950)    {
[951](https://docs.rs#951)        if let Some(node) = self.map.get_mut(KeyWrapper::from_ref(k)) {
[952](https://docs.rs#952)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[953](https://docs.rs#953)
[954](https://docs.rs#954)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[955](https://docs.rs#955)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[956](https://docs.rs#956)
[957](https://docs.rs#957)            unsafe { &mut *(*node_ptr).val.as_mut_ptr() }
[958](https://docs.rs#958)        } else {
[959](https://docs.rs#959)            let v = f();
[960](https://docs.rs#960)            let (_, node) = self.replace_or_create_node(k.to_owned(), v);
[961](https://docs.rs#961)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[962](https://docs.rs#962)
[963](https://docs.rs#963)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[964](https://docs.rs#964)
[965](https://docs.rs#965)            let keyref = unsafe { (*node_ptr).key.as_ptr() };
[966](https://docs.rs#966)            self.map.insert(KeyRef { k: keyref }, node);
[967](https://docs.rs#967)            unsafe { &mut *(*node_ptr).val.as_mut_ptr() }
[968](https://docs.rs#968)        }
[969](https://docs.rs#969)    }

[1118](https://docs.rs#1118)    /// Returns a reference to the value corresponding to the key in the cache or `None` if it is
[1119](https://docs.rs#1119)    /// not present in the cache. Unlike `get`, `peek` does not update the LRU list so the key's
[1120](https://docs.rs#1120)    /// position will be unchanged.
[1121](https://docs.rs#1121)    ///
[1122](https://docs.rs#1122)    /// # Example
[1123](https://docs.rs#1123)    ///
[1124](https://docs.rs#1124)    /// ```
[1125](https://docs.rs#1125)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[1126](https://docs.rs#1126)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[1127](https://docs.rs#1127)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[1128](https://docs.rs#1128)    ///
[1129](https://docs.rs#1129)    /// cache.put(1, "a");
[1130](https://docs.rs#1130)    /// cache.put(2, "b");
[1131](https://docs.rs#1131)    ///
[1132](https://docs.rs#1132)    /// assert_eq!(cache.peek(&1), Some(&"a"));
[1133](https://docs.rs#1133)    /// assert_eq!(cache.peek(&2), Some(&"b"));
[1134](https://docs.rs#1134)    /// ```
[1135](https://docs.rs#1135)    pub fn peek<'a, Q>(&'a self, k: &Q) -> Option<&'a V>
[1136](https://docs.rs#1136)    where
[1137](https://docs.rs#1137)        K: Borrow<Q>,
[1138](https://docs.rs#1138)        Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized,
[1139](https://docs.rs#1139)    {
[1140](https://docs.rs#1140)        self.map
[1141](https://docs.rs#1141)            .get(KeyWrapper::from_ref(k))
[1142](https://docs.rs#1142)            .map(|node| unsafe { &*node.as_ref().val.as_ptr() })
[1143](https://docs.rs#1143)    }

[1145](https://docs.rs#1145)    /// Returns a mutable reference to the value corresponding to the key in the cache or `None`
[1146](https://docs.rs#1146)    /// if it is not present in the cache. Unlike `get_mut`, `peek_mut` does not update the LRU
[1147](https://docs.rs#1147)    /// list so the key's position will be unchanged.
[1148](https://docs.rs#1148)    ///
[1149](https://docs.rs#1149)    /// # Example
[1150](https://docs.rs#1150)    ///

[1155](https://docs.rs#1155)    ///
[1156](https://docs.rs#1156)    /// cache.put(1, "a");
[1157](https://docs.rs#1157)    /// cache.put(2, "b");
[1158](https://docs.rs#1158)    ///
[1159](https://docs.rs#1159)    /// assert_eq!(cache.peek_mut(&1), Some(&mut "a"));

[1161](https://docs.rs#1161)    /// ```
[1162](https://docs.rs#1162)    pub fn peek_mut<'a, Q>(&'a mut self, k: &Q) -> Option<&'a mut V>
[1163](https://docs.rs#1163)    where
[1164](https://docs.rs#1164)        K: Borrow<Q>,
[1165](https://docs.rs#1165)        Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized,
[1166](https://docs.rs#1166)    {
[1167](https://docs.rs#1167)        match self.map.get_mut(KeyWrapper::from_ref(k)) {
[1168](https://docs.rs#1168)            None => None,
[1169](https://docs.rs#1169)            Some(node) => Some(unsafe { &mut *(*node.as_ptr()).val.as_mut_ptr() }),
[1170](https://docs.rs#1170)        }

[1173](https://docs.rs#1173)    /// Returns the value corresponding to the least recently used item or `None` if the

[1175](https://docs.rs#1175)    /// position will be unchanged.

[1178](https://docs.rs#1178)    ///
[1179](https://docs.rs#1179)    /// ```
[1180](https://docs.rs#1180)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[1181](https://docs.rs#1181)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[1182](https://docs.rs#1182)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[1183](https://docs.rs#1183)    ///
[1184](https://docs.rs#1184)    /// cache.put(1, "a");
[1185](https://docs.rs#1185)    /// cache.put(2, "b");
[1186](https://docs.rs#1186)    ///
[1187](https://docs.rs#1187)    /// assert_eq!(cache.peek_lru(), Some((&1, &"a")));
[1188](https://docs.rs#1188)    /// ```
[1189](https://docs.rs#1189)    pub fn peek_lru(&self) -> Option<(&K, &V)> {
[1190](https://docs.rs#1190)        if self.is_empty() {
[1191](https://docs.rs#1191)            return None;
[1192](https://docs.rs#1192)        }
[1193](https://docs.rs#1193)
[1194](https://docs.rs#1194)        let (key, val);
[1195](https://docs.rs#1195)        unsafe {
[1196](https://docs.rs#1196)            let node = (*self.tail).prev;
[1197](https://docs.rs#1197)            key = &(*(*node).key.as_ptr()) as &K;
[1198](https://docs.rs#1198)            val = &(*(*node).val.as_ptr()) as &V;
[1199](https://docs.rs#1199)        }
[1200](https://docs.rs#1200)
[1201](https://docs.rs#1201)        Some((key, val))
[1202](https://docs.rs#1202)    }

[1224](https://docs.rs#1224)
[1225](https://docs.rs#1225)        let (key, val);

[1228](https://docs.rs#1228)            key = &(*(*node).key.as_ptr()) as &K;
[1229](https://docs.rs#1229)            val = &(*(*node).val.as_ptr()) as &V;

[1278](https://docs.rs#1278)    pub fn pop<Q>(&mut self, k: &Q) -> Option<V>
[1279](https://docs.rs#1279)    where
[1280](https://docs.rs#1280)        K: Borrow<Q>,
[1281](https://docs.rs#1281)        Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized,
[1282](https://docs.rs#1282)    {
[1283](https://docs.rs#1283)        match self.map.remove(KeyWrapper::from_ref(k)) {
[1284](https://docs.rs#1284)            None => None,
[1285](https://docs.rs#1285)            Some(old_node) => {
[1286](https://docs.rs#1286)                let mut old_node = unsafe {
[1287](https://docs.rs#1287)                    let mut old_node = *Box::from_raw(old_node.as_ptr());
[1288](https://docs.rs#1288)                    ptr::drop_in_place(old_node.key.as_mut_ptr());
[1289](https://docs.rs#1289)
[1290](https://docs.rs#1290)                    old_node
[1291](https://docs.rs#1291)                };
[1292](https://docs.rs#1292)
[1293](https://docs.rs#1293)                self.detach(&mut old_node);
[1294](https://docs.rs#1294)
[1295](https://docs.rs#1295)                let LruEntry { key: _, val, .. } = old_node;
[1296](https://docs.rs#1296)                unsafe { Some(val.assume_init()) }
[1297](https://docs.rs#1297)            }
[1298](https://docs.rs#1298)        }
[1299](https://docs.rs#1299)    }

[1394](https://docs.rs#1394)    /// Marks the key as the most recently used one. Returns true if the key
[1395](https://docs.rs#1395)    /// was promoted because it exists in the cache, false otherwise.
[1396](https://docs.rs#1396)    ///
[1397](https://docs.rs#1397)    /// # Example
[1398](https://docs.rs#1398)    ///
[1399](https://docs.rs#1399)    /// ```
[1400](https://docs.rs#1400)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[1401](https://docs.rs#1401)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[1402](https://docs.rs#1402)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(3).unwrap());
[1403](https://docs.rs#1403)    ///
[1404](https://docs.rs#1404)    /// cache.put(1, "a");
[1405](https://docs.rs#1405)    /// cache.put(2, "b");
[1406](https://docs.rs#1406)    /// cache.put(3, "c");
[1407](https://docs.rs#1407)    /// cache.get(&1);
[1408](https://docs.rs#1408)    /// cache.get(&2);
[1409](https://docs.rs#1409)    ///
[1410](https://docs.rs#1410)    /// // If we do `pop_lru` now, we would pop 3.
[1411](https://docs.rs#1411)    /// // assert_eq!(cache.pop_lru(), Some((3, "c")));
[1412](https://docs.rs#1412)    ///
[1413](https://docs.rs#1413)    /// // By promoting 3, we make sure it isn't popped.
[1414](https://docs.rs#1414)    /// assert!(cache.promote(&3));
[1415](https://docs.rs#1415)    /// assert_eq!(cache.pop_lru(), Some((1, "a")));
[1416](https://docs.rs#1416)    ///
[1417](https://docs.rs#1417)    /// // Promoting an entry that doesn't exist doesn't do anything.
[1418](https://docs.rs#1418)    /// assert!(!cache.promote(&4));
[1419](https://docs.rs#1419)    /// ```
[1420](https://docs.rs#1420)    pub fn promote<Q>(&mut self, k: &Q) -> bool
[1421](https://docs.rs#1421)    where
[1422](https://docs.rs#1422)        K: Borrow<Q>,
[1423](https://docs.rs#1423)        Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized,
[1424](https://docs.rs#1424)    {
[1425](https://docs.rs#1425)        if let Some(node) = self.map.get_mut(KeyWrapper::from_ref(k)) {
[1426](https://docs.rs#1426)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[1427](https://docs.rs#1427)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[1428](https://docs.rs#1428)            self.attach(node_ptr);
[1429](https://docs.rs#1429)            true
[1430](https://docs.rs#1430)        } else {
[1431](https://docs.rs#1431)            false
[1432](https://docs.rs#1432)        }
[1433](https://docs.rs#1433)    }

[1435](https://docs.rs#1435)    /// Marks the key as the least recently used one. Returns true if the key was demoted

[1440](https://docs.rs#1440)    /// ```
[1441](https://docs.rs#1441)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[1442](https://docs.rs#1442)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[1443](https://docs.rs#1443)    /// let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(3).unwrap());
[1444](https://docs.rs#1444)    ///
[1445](https://docs.rs#1445)    /// cache.put(1, "a");

[1457](https://docs.rs#1457)    /// assert_eq!(cache.pop_lru(), Some((1, "a")));

[1462](https://docs.rs#1462)    /// ```
[1463](https://docs.rs#1463)    pub fn demote<Q>(&mut self, k: &Q) -> bool

[1465](https://docs.rs#1465)        K: Borrow<Q>,

[1469](https://docs.rs#1469)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = node.as_ptr();
[1470](https://docs.rs#1470)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[1471](https://docs.rs#1471)            self.attach_last(node_ptr);
[1472](https://docs.rs#1472)            true
[1473](https://docs.rs#1473)        } else {
[1474](https://docs.rs#1474)            false

[1532](https://docs.rs#1532)    /// Resizes the cache. If the new capacity is smaller than the size of the current
[1533](https://docs.rs#1533)    /// cache any entries past the new capacity are discarded.
[1534](https://docs.rs#1534)    ///
[1535](https://docs.rs#1535)    /// # Example
[1536](https://docs.rs#1536)    ///
[1537](https://docs.rs#1537)    /// ```
[1538](https://docs.rs#1538)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[1539](https://docs.rs#1539)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[1540](https://docs.rs#1540)    /// let mut cache: LruCache<isize, &str> = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[1541](https://docs.rs#1541)    ///
[1542](https://docs.rs#1542)    /// cache.put(1, "a");
[1543](https://docs.rs#1543)    /// cache.put(2, "b");
[1544](https://docs.rs#1544)    /// cache.resize(NonZeroUsize::new(4).unwrap());
[1545](https://docs.rs#1545)    /// cache.put(3, "c");
[1546](https://docs.rs#1546)    /// cache.put(4, "d");
[1547](https://docs.rs#1547)    ///
[1548](https://docs.rs#1548)    /// assert_eq!(cache.len(), 4);
[1549](https://docs.rs#1549)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&1), Some(&"a"));
[1550](https://docs.rs#1550)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&2), Some(&"b"));
[1551](https://docs.rs#1551)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&3), Some(&"c"));
[1552](https://docs.rs#1552)    /// assert_eq!(cache.get(&4), Some(&"d"));
[1553](https://docs.rs#1553)    /// ```
[1554](https://docs.rs#1554)    pub fn resize(&mut self, cap: NonZeroUsize) {
[1555](https://docs.rs#1555)        // return early if capacity doesn't change
[1556](https://docs.rs#1556)        if cap == self.cap {
[1557](https://docs.rs#1557)            return;
[1558](https://docs.rs#1558)        }
[1559](https://docs.rs#1559)
[1560](https://docs.rs#1560)        while self.map.len() > cap.get() {
[1561](https://docs.rs#1561)            self.pop_lru();
[1562](https://docs.rs#1562)        }
[1563](https://docs.rs#1563)        self.map.shrink_to_fit();
[1564](https://docs.rs#1564)
[1565](https://docs.rs#1565)        self.cap = cap;
[1566](https://docs.rs#1566)    }
[1567](https://docs.rs#1567)
[1568](https://docs.rs#1568)    /// Clears the contents of the cache.
[1569](https://docs.rs#1569)    ///
[1570](https://docs.rs#1570)    /// # Example
[1571](https://docs.rs#1571)    ///
[1572](https://docs.rs#1572)    /// ```
[1573](https://docs.rs#1573)    /// use lru::LruCache;
[1574](https://docs.rs#1574)    /// use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
[1575](https://docs.rs#1575)    /// let mut cache: LruCache<isize, &str> = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[1576](https://docs.rs#1576)    /// assert_eq!(cache.len(), 0);
[1577](https://docs.rs#1577)    ///
[1578](https://docs.rs#1578)    /// cache.put(1, "a");
[1579](https://docs.rs#1579)    /// assert_eq!(cache.len(), 1);
[1580](https://docs.rs#1580)    ///
[1581](https://docs.rs#1581)    /// cache.put(2, "b");
[1582](https://docs.rs#1582)    /// assert_eq!(cache.len(), 2);
[1583](https://docs.rs#1583)    ///
[1584](https://docs.rs#1584)    /// cache.clear();
[1585](https://docs.rs#1585)    /// assert_eq!(cache.len(), 0);
[1586](https://docs.rs#1586)    /// ```
[1587](https://docs.rs#1587)    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
[1588](https://docs.rs#1588)        while self.pop_lru().is_some() {}
[1589](https://docs.rs#1589)    }

[1618](https://docs.rs#1618)    /// An iterator visiting all entries in most-recently-used order, giving a mutable reference on

[1646](https://docs.rs#1646)        IterMut {
[1647](https://docs.rs#1647)            len: self.len(),
[1648](https://docs.rs#1648)            ptr: unsafe { (*self.head).next },
[1649](https://docs.rs#1649)            end: unsafe { (*self.tail).prev },
[1650](https://docs.rs#1650)            phantom: PhantomData,
[1651](https://docs.rs#1651)        }
[1652](https://docs.rs#1652)    }
[1653](https://docs.rs#1653)
[1654](https://docs.rs#1654)    fn remove_first(&mut self) -> Option<Box<LruEntry<K, V>>> {
[1655](https://docs.rs#1655)        let next;
[1656](https://docs.rs#1656)        unsafe { next = (*self.head).next }
[1657](https://docs.rs#1657)        if !core::ptr::eq(next, self.tail) {
[1658](https://docs.rs#1658)            let old_key = KeyRef {
[1659](https://docs.rs#1659)                k: unsafe { &(*(*(*self.head).next).key.as_ptr()) },
[1660](https://docs.rs#1660)            };
[1661](https://docs.rs#1661)            let old_node = self.map.remove(&old_key).unwrap();
[1662](https://docs.rs#1662)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = old_node.as_ptr();
[1663](https://docs.rs#1663)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[1664](https://docs.rs#1664)            unsafe { Some(Box::from_raw(node_ptr)) }
[1665](https://docs.rs#1665)        } else {
[1666](https://docs.rs#1666)            None
[1667](https://docs.rs#1667)        }
[1668](https://docs.rs#1668)    }
[1669](https://docs.rs#1669)
[1670](https://docs.rs#1670)    fn remove_last(&mut self) -> Option<Box<LruEntry<K, V>>> {
[1671](https://docs.rs#1671)        let prev;
[1672](https://docs.rs#1672)        unsafe { prev = (*self.tail).prev }
[1673](https://docs.rs#1673)        if !core::ptr::eq(prev, self.head) {
[1674](https://docs.rs#1674)            let old_key = KeyRef {
[1675](https://docs.rs#1675)                k: unsafe { &(*(*(*self.tail).prev).key.as_ptr()) },
[1676](https://docs.rs#1676)            };
[1677](https://docs.rs#1677)            let old_node = self.map.remove(&old_key).unwrap();
[1678](https://docs.rs#1678)            let node_ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V> = old_node.as_ptr();
[1679](https://docs.rs#1679)            self.detach(node_ptr);
[1680](https://docs.rs#1680)            unsafe { Some(Box::from_raw(node_ptr)) }
[1681](https://docs.rs#1681)        } else {
[1682](https://docs.rs#1682)            None
[1683](https://docs.rs#1683)        }
[1684](https://docs.rs#1684)    }
[1685](https://docs.rs#1685)
[1686](https://docs.rs#1686)    fn detach(&mut self, node: *mut LruEntry<K, V>) {
[1687](https://docs.rs#1687)        unsafe {
[1688](https://docs.rs#1688)            (*(*node).prev).next = (*node).next;
[1689](https://docs.rs#1689)            (*(*node).next).prev = (*node).prev;
[1690](https://docs.rs#1690)        }
[1691](https://docs.rs#1691)    }
[1692](https://docs.rs#1692)
[1693](https://docs.rs#1693)    // Attaches `node` after the sigil `self.head` node.
[1694](https://docs.rs#1694)    fn attach(&mut self, node: *mut LruEntry<K, V>) {
[1695](https://docs.rs#1695)        unsafe {
[1696](https://docs.rs#1696)            (*node).next = (*self.head).next;
[1697](https://docs.rs#1697)            (*node).prev = self.head;
[1698](https://docs.rs#1698)            (*self.head).next = node;
[1699](https://docs.rs#1699)            (*(*node).next).prev = node;
[1700](https://docs.rs#1700)        }
[1701](https://docs.rs#1701)    }
[1702](https://docs.rs#1702)
[1703](https://docs.rs#1703)    // Attaches `node` before the sigil `self.tail` node.
[1704](https://docs.rs#1704)    fn attach_last(&mut self, node: *mut LruEntry<K, V>) {
[1705](https://docs.rs#1705)        unsafe {
[1706](https://docs.rs#1706)            (*node).next = self.tail;
[1707](https://docs.rs#1707)            (*node).prev = (*self.tail).prev;
[1708](https://docs.rs#1708)            (*self.tail).prev = node;
[1709](https://docs.rs#1709)            (*(*node).prev).next = node;
[1710](https://docs.rs#1710)        }
[1711](https://docs.rs#1711)    }

[1714](https://docs.rs#1714)impl<K, V, S> Drop for LruCache<K, V, S> {
[1715](https://docs.rs#1715)    fn drop(&mut self) {
[1716](https://docs.rs#1716)        self.map.drain().for_each(|(_, node)| unsafe {
[1717](https://docs.rs#1717)            let mut node = *Box::from_raw(node.as_ptr());
[1718](https://docs.rs#1718)            ptr::drop_in_place((node).key.as_mut_ptr());
[1719](https://docs.rs#1719)            ptr::drop_in_place((node).val.as_mut_ptr());
[1720](https://docs.rs#1720)        });
[1721](https://docs.rs#1721)        // We rebox the head/tail, and because these are maybe-uninit
[1722](https://docs.rs#1722)        // they do not have the absent k/v dropped.
[1723](https://docs.rs#1723)
[1724](https://docs.rs#1724)        let _head = unsafe { *Box::from_raw(self.head) };
[1725](https://docs.rs#1725)        let _tail = unsafe { *Box::from_raw(self.tail) };
[1726](https://docs.rs#1726)    }
[1727](https://docs.rs#1727)}

[1839](https://docs.rs#1839)/// An iterator over mutables entries of a `LruCache`.
[1840](https://docs.rs#1840)///
[1841](https://docs.rs#1841)/// This `struct` is created by the [`iter_mut`] method on [`LruCache`][`LruCache`]. See its
[1842](https://docs.rs#1842)/// documentation for more.
[1843](https://docs.rs#1843)///
[1844](https://docs.rs#1844)/// [`iter_mut`]: struct.LruCache.html#method.iter_mut
[1845](https://docs.rs#1845)/// [`LruCache`]: struct.LruCache.html
[1846](https://docs.rs#1846)pub struct IterMut<'a, K: 'a, V: 'a> {
[1847](https://docs.rs#1847)    len: usize,
[1848](https://docs.rs#1848)
[1849](https://docs.rs#1849)    ptr: *mut LruEntry<K, V>,
[1850](https://docs.rs#1850)    end: *mut LruEntry<K, V>,
[1851](https://docs.rs#1851)
[1852](https://docs.rs#1852)    phantom: PhantomData<&'a K>,
[1853](https://docs.rs#1853)}
[1854](https://docs.rs#1854)
[1855](https://docs.rs#1855)impl<'a, K, V> Iterator for IterMut<'a, K, V> {
[1856](https://docs.rs#1856)    type Item = (&'a K, &'a mut V);
[1857](https://docs.rs#1857)
[1858](https://docs.rs#1858)    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<(&'a K, &'a mut V)> {
[1859](https://docs.rs#1859)        if self.len == 0 {
[1860](https://docs.rs#1860)            return None;
[1861](https://docs.rs#1861)        }
[1862](https://docs.rs#1862)
[1863](https://docs.rs#1863)        let key = unsafe { &(*(*self.ptr).key.as_ptr()) as &K };
[1864](https://docs.rs#1864)        let val = unsafe { &mut (*(*self.ptr).val.as_mut_ptr()) as &mut V };
[1865](https://docs.rs#1865)
[1866](https://docs.rs#1866)        self.len -= 1;
[1867](https://docs.rs#1867)        self.ptr = unsafe { (*self.ptr).next };
[1868](https://docs.rs#1868)
[1869](https://docs.rs#1869)        Some((key, val))
[1870](https://docs.rs#1870)    }
[1871](https://docs.rs#1871)
[1872](https://docs.rs#1872)    fn size_hint(&self) -> (usize, Option<usize>) {
[1873](https://docs.rs#1873)        (self.len, Some(self.len))
[1874](https://docs.rs#1874)    }
[1875](https://docs.rs#1875)
[1876](https://docs.rs#1876)    fn count(self) -> usize {
[1877](https://docs.rs#1877)        self.len
[1878](https://docs.rs#1878)    }
[1879](https://docs.rs#1879)}
[1880](https://docs.rs#1880)
[1881](https://docs.rs#1881)impl<'a, K, V> DoubleEndedIterator for IterMut<'a, K, V> {
[1882](https://docs.rs#1882)    fn next_back(&mut self) -> Option<(&'a K, &'a mut V)> {
[1883](https://docs.rs#1883)        if self.len == 0 {
[1884](https://docs.rs#1884)            return None;
[1885](https://docs.rs#1885)        }
[1886](https://docs.rs#1886)
[1887](https://docs.rs#1887)        let key = unsafe { &(*(*self.end).key.as_ptr()) as &K };
[1888](https://docs.rs#1888)        let val = unsafe { &mut (*(*self.end).val.as_mut_ptr()) as &mut V };
[1889](https://docs.rs#1889)
[1890](https://docs.rs#1890)        self.len -= 1;
[1891](https://docs.rs#1891)        self.end = unsafe { (*self.end).prev };
[1892](https://docs.rs#1892)
[1893](https://docs.rs#1893)        Some((key, val))
[1894](https://docs.rs#1894)    }
[1895](https://docs.rs#1895)}
[1896](https://docs.rs#1896)
[1897](https://docs.rs#1897)impl<'a, K, V> ExactSizeIterator for IterMut<'a, K, V> {}

[1905](https://docs.rs#1905)/// An iterator that moves out of a `LruCache`.
[1906](https://docs.rs#1906)///
[1907](https://docs.rs#1907)/// This `struct` is created by the [`into_iter`] method on [`LruCache`][`LruCache`]. See its
[1908](https://docs.rs#1908)/// documentation for more.
[1909](https://docs.rs#1909)///
[1910](https://docs.rs#1910)/// [`into_iter`]: struct.LruCache.html#method.into_iter
[1911](https://docs.rs#1911)/// [`LruCache`]: struct.LruCache.html
[1912](https://docs.rs#1912)pub struct IntoIter<K, V>
[1913](https://docs.rs#1913)where
[1914](https://docs.rs#1914)    K: Hash + Eq,
[1915](https://docs.rs#1915){
[1916](https://docs.rs#1916)    cache: LruCache<K, V>,
[1917](https://docs.rs#1917)}
[1918](https://docs.rs#1918)
[1919](https://docs.rs#1919)impl<K, V> Iterator for IntoIter<K, V>
[1920](https://docs.rs#1920)where
[1921](https://docs.rs#1921)    K: Hash + Eq,
[1922](https://docs.rs#1922){
[1923](https://docs.rs#1923)    type Item = (K, V);
[1924](https://docs.rs#1924)
[1925](https://docs.rs#1925)    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<(K, V)> {
[1926](https://docs.rs#1926)        self.cache.pop_lru()
[1927](https://docs.rs#1927)    }
[1928](https://docs.rs#1928)
[1929](https://docs.rs#1929)    fn size_hint(&self) -> (usize, Option<usize>) {
[1930](https://docs.rs#1930)        let len = self.cache.len();
[1931](https://docs.rs#1931)        (len, Some(len))
[1932](https://docs.rs#1932)    }
[1933](https://docs.rs#1933)
[1934](https://docs.rs#1934)    fn count(self) -> usize {
[1935](https://docs.rs#1935)        self.cache.len()
[1936](https://docs.rs#1936)    }

[2147](https://docs.rs#2147)        let mut cache = LruCache::<Rc<String>, String>::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[2148](https://docs.rs#2148)        let f = || -> Result<String, ()> { Err(()) };
[2149](https://docs.rs#2149)        let a = || -> Result<String, ()> { Ok("One".to_owned()) };
[2150](https://docs.rs#2150)        let b = || -> Result<String, ()> { Ok("Two".to_owned()) };

[2153](https://docs.rs#2153)        assert_eq!(cache.try_get_or_insert_ref(&key2, b), Ok(&"Two".to_owned()));
[2154](https://docs.rs#2154)        assert_eq!(cache.try_get_or_insert_ref(&key2, a), Ok(&"Two".to_owned()));
[2155](https://docs.rs#2155)        assert_eq!(cache.len(), 2);
[2156](https://docs.rs#2156)        assert_eq!(Rc::strong_count(&key1), 2);
[2157](https://docs.rs#2157)        assert_eq!(Rc::strong_count(&key2), 2);

[2175](https://docs.rs#2175)        assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_mut("apple", || "orange"), &"blue");
[2176](https://docs.rs#2176)        assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_mut("banana", || "orange"), &"yellow");
[2177](https://docs.rs#2177)        assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_mut("lemon", || "orange"), &"orange");
[2178](https://docs.rs#2178)        assert_eq!(cache.get_or_insert_mut("lemon", || "red"), &"orange");
[2179](https://docs.rs#2179)    }

[2224](https://docs.rs#2224)        cache.put(2, "c");
[2225](https://docs.rs#2225)
[2226](https://docs.rs#2226)        let f = || -> Result<&str, &str> { Err("failed") };
[2227](https://docs.rs#2227)        let a = || -> Result<&str, &str> { Ok("a") };
[2228](https://docs.rs#2228)        let b = || -> Result<&str, &str> { Ok("b") };
[2229](https://docs.rs#2229)        if let Ok(v) = cache.try_get_or_insert_mut(2, a) {
[2230](https://docs.rs#2230)            *v = "d";

[2232](https://docs.rs#2232)        assert_eq!(cache.try_get_or_insert_mut(2, a), Ok(&mut "d"));
[2233](https://docs.rs#2233)        assert_eq!(cache.try_get_or_insert_mut(3, f), Err("failed"));
[2234](https://docs.rs#2234)        assert_eq!(cache.try_get_or_insert_mut(4, b), Ok(&mut "b"));
[2235](https://docs.rs#2235)        assert_eq!(cache.try_get_or_insert_mut(4, a), Ok(&mut "b"));
[2236](https://docs.rs#2236)    }

[2239](https://docs.rs#2239)    fn test_try_get_or_insert_mut_with_key() {
[2240](https://docs.rs#2240)        let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[2241](https://docs.rs#2241)
[2242](https://docs.rs#2242)        cache.put("One", 1);
[2243](https://docs.rs#2243)        cache.put("Two", 2);
[2244](https://docs.rs#2244)        cache.put("Two", 3);
[2245](https://docs.rs#2245)
[2246](https://docs.rs#2246)        let f = |_: &&str| -> Result<usize, &str> { Err("failed") };
[2247](https://docs.rs#2247)        let len = |k: &&str| -> Result<usize, &str> { Ok(k.len()) };
[2248](https://docs.rs#2248)        let zero = |_: &&str| -> Result<usize, &str> { Ok(0) };
[2249](https://docs.rs#2249)        if let Ok(v) = cache.try_get_or_insert_mut_with_key("Two", f) {
[2250](https://docs.rs#2250)            *v = 6;
[2251](https://docs.rs#2251)        }
[2252](https://docs.rs#2252)        assert_eq!(cache.try_get_or_insert_mut_with_key("Two", len), Ok(&mut 6));
[2253](https://docs.rs#2253)        assert_eq!(
[2254](https://docs.rs#2254)            cache.try_get_or_insert_mut_with_key("Three", f),
[2255](https://docs.rs#2255)            Err("failed")
[2256](https://docs.rs#2256)        );
[2257](https://docs.rs#2257)        assert_eq!(
[2258](https://docs.rs#2258)            cache.try_get_or_insert_mut_with_key("Four", len),
[2259](https://docs.rs#2259)            Ok(&mut 4)
[2260](https://docs.rs#2260)        );
[2261](https://docs.rs#2261)        assert_eq!(
[2262](https://docs.rs#2262)            cache.try_get_or_insert_mut_with_key("Four", zero),
[2263](https://docs.rs#2263)            Ok(&mut 4)
[2264](https://docs.rs#2264)        );
[2265](https://docs.rs#2265)    }

[2270](https://docs.rs#2270)        use alloc::string::String;

[2338](https://docs.rs#2338)    fn test_put_removes_oldest() {
[2339](https://docs.rs#2339)        let mut cache = LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(2).unwrap());
[2340](https://docs.rs#2340)
[2341](https://docs.rs#2341)        assert_eq!(cache.put("apple", "red"), None);
[2342](https://docs.rs#2342)        assert_eq!(cache.put("banana", "yellow"), None);
[2343](https://docs.rs#2343)        assert_eq!(cache.put("pear", "green"), None);
[2344](https://docs.rs#2344)
[2345](https://docs.rs#2345)        assert!(cache.get(&"apple").is_none());
[2346](https://docs.rs#2346)        assert_opt_eq(cache.get(&"banana"), "yellow");
[2347](https://docs.rs#2347)        assert_opt_eq(cache.get(&"pear"), "green");
[2348](https://docs.rs#2348)
[2349](https://docs.rs#2349)        // Even though we inserted "apple" into the cache earlier it has since been removed from
[2350](https://docs.rs#2350)        // the cache so there is no current value for `put` to return.
[2351](https://docs.rs#2351)        assert_eq!(cache.put("apple", "green"), None);
[2352](https://docs.rs#2352)        assert_eq!(cache.put("tomato", "red"), None);
[2353](https://docs.rs#2353)
[2354](https://docs.rs#2354)        assert!(cache.get(&"pear").is_none());
[2355](https://docs.rs#2355)        assert_opt_eq(cache.get(&"apple"), "green");
[2356](https://docs.rs#2356)        assert_opt_eq(cache.get(&"tomato"), "red");
[2357](https://docs.rs#2357)    }
